understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by activating each goal cell. A goal activates only when the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation all match the goal's requirements, then the piece must step onto that goal.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life and resets stamina. Walls block movement, so blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. Stamina refills restore stamina, activated goals advance progress, and losing all lives ends the game.
